configuration.loadFailedBody: Could not read the settings. Reload the page to try again.

account.empty: No account is connected for this drive yet. Paste credentials to connect one, or set a callback base URL and authorize in the browser.
account.forgetBody: Peach will forget {{name}}'s credentials and stop syncing this account; its libraries go away with it. Entries already scanned stay in the library, and authorizing again picks syncing back up.
account.name: Account name
account.nameHelp: Distinguishes accounts when one drive has several; blank uses the drive name. The value becomes [drive.accounts.<name>] in the settings file.
account.refreshed: Refresh of {{name}} queued; the next sync round starts with it

mode.proxyHelp: The browser only talks to Peach; Peach fetches the bytes from the drive by range and relays them, so it uses server bandwidth.
mode.redirectHelp: The browser fetches the bytes from the drive itself; Peach only hands out a pre-authorized temporary address, so no server bandwidth is used.

manual.help: Connect without the browser flow: paste the drive app's client ID, client secret and refresh token and Peach renews the token itself. All three must come from the same app.
manual.rootHelp: A directory path such as AV/示例合集 or a remote directory id; a filled value becomes this account's only library. Leave it empty and pick directories on the libraries tab.

callback.help: Start authorization uses this address to send the browser back to Peach: the redirect URI registered with the drive is this address plus /oauth/drive/callback. Leave it empty if you only use "Enter credentials".
callback.label: Callback base
callback.title: Authorization callback base

add.accountHelp: A library lives in a directory of one account.
add.idempotent: Adding the same directory twice still leaves one library.
add.noAccount: Connect an account on the drives tab first, then come back to pick a directory.
add.title: Add library

library.colorHelp: The colour band on the card; nothing is coloured by default.
library.empty: No libraries yet. Pick a drive directory below.

folder.hint: Pick this level and every subdirectory under it is scanned too.
folder.start: Open the directory you want; its subdirectories come along.

library.foldersMore_one: {{count, number}} more directory of this account belongs to the same library.
library.foldersMore_other: {{count, number}} more directories of this account belong to the same library.
library.intro: One drive directory is one library. Adding it only tells Peach to scan it; removing it only stops the scan, and entries already scanned stay.
library.name: Name
library.nameHelp: The name shown on the card and in lists.
library.policyHelp: Whether scanned items are processed automatically.
library.removeBody: This only stops scanning the directory. Entries already scanned stay in the library and come back when you add the same directory again.
library.stagesHelp: With custom processing, only the checked steps run.
library.title: Libraries

interfaceLanguage.help: Auto follows your browser language, then the system language.
interfaceLanguage.title: Language
interfaceLanguage.unavailable: Couldn't read the language from the database. Reopen settings.
